candidate_mode_policy: A law-break signal is an adjudication-level candidate mode switch, not an observed q_k and not a predeclared mechanism label.
future_use: Right rates, J, successor capability and successor predictions are adjudication targets only and never candidate inputs or selection features.
classification_rule: A class is assigned from persistent leave-one-run-out stable-envelope crossings. If multiple structural/readout signals cross in the event interval, report combined_mechanism and preserve their earliest order.
fail_closed: Absence of a persistent crossing is reported as no_persistent_breakpoint_detected; thresholds are never retuned per event.
